# GitHub Copilot

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It is the
canonical guidance for this repository; do not duplicate project rules here.

When proposing or reviewing changes, run the checks listed under "Build,
lint, and test" in `AGENTS.md` (`ci-scripts/lint.sh` and `ci-scripts/test.sh`)
and keep `CHANGELOG.md` and `website/docs/` in step with user-visible changes.
